summary: A man passionately tells a woman on a bridge that they need to follow their passions, contrasting her robotics with his desire to be "awesome in space."

dialogue.speaker: MAN
dialogue.text: Lia, we have to follow our passions. You have your robotics and I just want to be awesome in space.
dialogue.delivery: Animated and earnest, expressing a strong belief in pursuing individual dreams.

visuals.description: A man and a woman stand on a black metal bridge railing over a canal. The man, on the left, speaks animatedly, gesturing with his hands. The woman, on the right, listens intently, leaning on the railing with her robotic right arm. Trees and buildings line the canal in the background under an overcast sky.
